name: wallaflare
description: A lightweight, zero-cost serverless Wallabag v2 API replacement and read-it-later service for Cloudflare Workers, D1, and E-ink readers (KOReader).

scripts.dev: if [ -f wrangler.personal.toml ]; then wrangler dev --config wrangler.personal.toml; else wrangler dev; fi
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && if [ -f wrangler.personal.toml ]; then wrangler deploy --config wrangler.personal.toml; else wrangler deploy; fi
scripts.db:migrate:remote: if [ -f wrangler.personal.toml ]; then wrangler d1 execute wallaflare-db --config wrangler.personal.toml --remote --file=./schema.sql --yes; else wrangler d1 execute wallaflare-db --remote --file=./schema.sql --yes; fi
scripts.build:apk: tsx scripts/build-web.ts && npx cap sync android && cd android && export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-$HOME/.jdks/jdk-21}" && export ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}" && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
scripts.build:apk:release: tsx scripts/build-web.ts && npx cap sync android && cd android && export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-$HOME/.jdks/jdk-21}" && export ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}" && ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon

AUTH_TOKEN.description: Create a secure master password to log into your Wallaflare dashboard and API.
